description: Root-of-trust manifest for the C2 effectiveness freeze. It stores the SHA-256 of docs/evidence/effectiveness-freeze.json, which is the file that contains all decision rules and therefore could otherwise be edited silently (the pre-C2 self-hash gap, finding F5 / error E07).

voided_v1_hashes.note: SHA-256 of the pre-C2 Chinese v1 documents, retained verbatim for audit from docs/TASK-LOG.md (the 'void the pre-C2 frozen round' entry). v1 is VOID, not deleted, not edited, not scored.

rules.primary_rule: Changing ANY frozen artifact (any file in frozen_artifacts, the freeze file, or this manifest) WITHOUT a NEW freeze id VOIDS the round. This closes the post-hoc rule-change loophole: editing a decision rule changes a recorded digest that can be checked, firing E07.
rules.correction_voids_round: A correction (localization, defect fix, rule change, added card, changed alpha) VOIDS the current round. The voided round is preserved as evidence, NOT scored, NOT deleted, NOT edited.
rules.no_same_id_rerun: A voided round CANNOT be silently re-run under the same freeze id. Re-running the SAME freeze id after a correction is prohibited.
rules.new_round_requirements: Any NEW round requires a NEW freeze id and NEW hashes for every frozen artifact. The new round starts from a clean slate.
rules.scored_fail_is_final: Within one live freeze id, a scored FAIL is a recorded result: 'FAIL must not be deleted / no retest' applies and it cannot be erased by re-running. Across freeze ids, a correction voids the whole round (unscored) and a new freeze id begins. There is NO path that changes a rule and re-runs under the same freeze.
rules.veto: E07 (frozen artifact changed) or E08 (unblinding) is a veto -> three-cell label FAIL + round VOID; recovery is a NEW freeze id, never a same-id re-run.

integrity_anchor.note: This manifest is the root of trust. It stores the hash of the freeze file (which holds the decision rules) but does NOT store a hash of itself. Its own integrity is anchored externally by the main session: the main session records this manifest's SHA-256 in docs/TASK-LOG.md (append-only, main-session-owned) and commits the frozen set to git. P4 does NOT write docs/TASK-LOG.md.
integrity_anchor.detection: Any sha256sum comparison of the frozen set or of this manifest against the recorded digests detects an edit and fires E07.

verification.check: A Python snippet loads both JSON files and verifies the two document hashes, the freeze hash in frozen_artifacts / freeze_file_sha256, 2^8=256, p_min <= alpha, 2 cards per 2x2 cell, and exactly 4 self_check cases.
